name: Plusle
description: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.

moves.name: Growl
moves.description: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Play Nice
moves.description: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Spark
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Switcheroo
moves.description: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Copycat
moves.description: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Last Resort
moves.description: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Entrainment
moves.description: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.description: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Charge
moves.description: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.description: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.description: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.description: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Electric Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Alluring Voice
moves.description: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

moves.name: Sing
moves.description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Sweet Kiss
moves.description: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Wish
moves.description: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.

moves.name: Nuzzle
moves.description: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
